title: Warnings & Threats with Como
goal: Use como + present or perfect subjunctive to issue warnings and contrast it with causal como + indicative
grammar: como-condicional-subjuntivo: como + subjunctive (warning/threat) vs como + indicative (cause)

items: I can issue a warning or threat with *como* + present or perfect subjunctive.
I can distinguish conditional *como* + subjunctive (warning) from causal *como* + indicative (reason).
I know that *como* + subjunctive is colloquial and more frequent in Spain, while *si* is more usual in Latin America.
